## Combo 2-974-2472

Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}
Produces: Infinite colored mana; Infinite Treasure tokens; Infinite artifact tokens; Infinite copies of tokens you control; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite storm count
Start: There and Back Again (battlefield); Song of the Worldsoul (battlefield); Ancestral Statue (hand)
Prerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Steps: At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
  Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
  Song of the Worldsoul triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
  Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
  When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
  Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
  Repeat from step 2.
  Once you have infinite colored mana, you may use Song of the Worldsoul's trigger to target any other token you control instead.

## Combo 8-24

## Combo 30-147-413
Cards: Storm of Souls + Blasting Station + Dualcaster Mage
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 13 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {5}{R}{R}{W}{W}
Produces: Infinite damage; Infinite recursion of creature cards in your graveyard; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers
Start: Storm of Souls (hand); Blasting Station (battlefield); Dualcaster Mage (hand)
Prerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
Steps: Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
  Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
  When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Storm of Souls.
  Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
  Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
  Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls.
  Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 3.
Notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}
Produces: Infinite lifegain; Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Animation Module (battlefield); Cleric Class (battlefield: is at least level 2); Soul's Attendant (battlefield); Thermopod (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
Steps: Gain life.
  Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
  Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
  When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
  Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
  Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
  Repeat from step 3.

## Combo 248-372-1734
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Changeling Berserker + Fiend Hunter
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 17 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Berserker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Fiend Hunter must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 13 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Changeling Berserker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Hero (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Lumbering Battlement (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
  When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
  When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  Together Forever triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand.
  Repeat.

## Combo 276-1775-2968

  Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
  Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
Notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 13 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite damage; Each opponent with an even life total loses the game
Start: Heartless Hidetsugu (battlefield: without summoning sickness ); Angrath's Marauders (battlefield); With Great Power . . . (battlefield: attached to any creature you control)
Prerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
  Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness
  At least one opponent has an even life total
  You have an odd life total
Steps: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to With Great Power....
  Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each player equal to half their life total, rounded down, then doubled.
  Each player who started with an even life ottal loses the game for having 0 or less life.
Notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

## Combo 331-1775-2968
Cards: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer + Ajani's Presence + Furnace of Rath
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 5 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}{W}{W}
Produces: Infinite damage to one opponent
Start: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer (battlefield); Ajani's Presence (hand); Furnace of Rath (battlefield)
Prerequisites: An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
  You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
Steps: Cast Ajani's Presence by paying {2}{W}{W} total, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
  Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Furnace of Rath.
  Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Furnace of Rath.
  Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Furnace of Rath.
  Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
  Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
Notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (battlefield); Against All Odds (hand); Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak (exile: exiled by Abdel Adrian)

  Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
  Repeat.

## Combo 372-1734-4846
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Worldgorger Dragon + Fiend Hunter
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 36 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Fiend Hunter must be exiled by Abdel Adrian, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Steps: Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
  Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning The Immortal Weapons and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
  Abdel Adrian and The Immortal Weapons trigger.
  Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
  Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
  Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling The Immortal Weapons and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
  Repeat.

  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Zidane, Tantalus Thief (battlefield); Confusion in the Ranks (battlefield); Grand Abolisher (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact, creature, or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
  An opponent controls an artifact.
  If you are going to have a nonartifact creature or enchantment enter the battlefield, an opponent must also control either a creature or enchantment respectively.
Steps: Cause an artifact, creature or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
  Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the permanent that entered with an opponent for another permanent of the same type.
  Zidane triggers, creating a Treasure token.
  When the Treasure enters, Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the Treasure with an opponent for another artifact.
  Repeat from step 3.
Notes: Grand Abolisher prevents the opponents from sacrificing the Treasures for mana. Without it, your opponents can sacrifice the Treasures and stop you (eventually) from exchanging control of artifacts.

## Combo 1605-1775-2968
Cards: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer + Ajani's Presence + Gratuitous Violence
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}{W}{W}
Produces: Infinite damage to one opponent
Start: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer (battlefield); Ajani's Presence (hand); Gratuitous Violence (battlefield)
Prerequisites: An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
  You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
Steps: Cast Ajani's Presence by paying {2}{W}{W} total, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
  Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Gratuitous Violence.
  Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Gratuitous Violence.
  Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Gratuitous Violence.
  Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
  Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
Notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

## Combo 1734-1938-4846
Cards: Worldgorger Dragon + Fiend Hunter + Glorious Protector
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 15 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}
Produces: Infinite damage; Infinite red mana; Infinite rummaging; Infinite death triggers; Infinite draw triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite self-discard triggers
Start: Nim Deathmantle (battlefield); Goblin Bombardment (battlefield); Famished Foragers (battlefield); Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines (battlefield)
Prerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
Steps: Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
  When Famished Foragers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
  When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
  Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
  Repeat.
  Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.

## Combo 1775-2474-6488
Cards: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer + Deathless Angel + City on Fire
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 3 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {W}{W}{W}{W}
Produces: Infinite damage to one opponent
Start: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer (battlefield); Deathless Angel (battlefield); City on Fire (battlefield)
Prerequisites: An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
  You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
Steps: Activate Deathless Angel twice by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
  Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to City on Fire.
  Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to City on Fire.
  Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to City on Fire.
  Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
  Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
Notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

## Combo 1938-3839-4846

  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 3 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite card draw at the beginning of the next upkeep; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite storm count; Infinite draw triggers at the beginning of the next upkeep; Infinitely powerful creature until end of turn
Start: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle (battlefield); Scrap Trawler (graveyard); Mishra's Bauble (hand); Krark-Clan Grunt (battlefield)
Steps: Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
  Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
  Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
  When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
  Repeat.

## Combo 2481-2790
Cards: Angel of Destiny + Seize the Day
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 2-3+ (Oddball) | Popularity: 200 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {5}{R}{R}
Produces: Each opponent loses the game
Start: Angel of Destiny (battlefield); Seize the Day (hand)
Prerequisites: Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
  Opponents are unable to block and kill Angel of Destiny.
  Your life total is at least 11 greater than your starting life total plus an additional 2 life for each opponent beyond the first.
  You have no more than three opponents.
Steps: Deal combat damage to an opponent using Angel of Destiny.
  Angel of Destiny's first ability triggers, causing you and the opponent to gain life equal to the damage dealt.
  Move to your postcombat main phase.
  Cast Seize the Day by paying {3}{R}, untapping Angel of Destiny and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
  Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time, attacking a different opponent.
  Cast Seize the Day from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}, untapping Angel of Destiny and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
  Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time, attacking a different opponent.
  At the beginning of your end step, Angel of Destiny triggers, causing each opponent it attacked this turn to lose the game.

## Combo 2506-2781
Cards: Molten Echoes + Felidar Guardian
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 640 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{W}
Produces: Infinite colored mana; Infinite creature tokens with haste; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Molten Echoes (battlefield); Felidar Guardian (hand)
Prerequisites: "Cat" or "Beast" chosen with Molten Echoes.
Steps: Cast Felidar Guardian.
  On ETB, both Felidar Guardian and Molten Echoes trigger; resolve the triggers in that order.
  Target a land that ETBs untapped with Felidar Guardian, floating mana and blinking it.
  Resolve Molten Echoes' trigger, creating a Felidar Guardian token copy.
  Blink the original Felidar Guardian with the token's ETB Blink trigger.
  The original Felidar Guardian ETBs, repeating the loop from the top for infinite mana and infinite hasty cat tokens.

## Combo 2506-3839
Cards: Molten Echoes + Changeling Hero
Color identity: RW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 450 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{W}
Produces: Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB
Start: Molten Echoes (battlefield); Changeling Hero (hand)
Prerequisites: any creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
Steps: Cast Changeling Hero by paying its mana cost.
  When Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
  Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Changeling Hero with haste.
  When the Changeling Hero token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Changeling Hero until the token Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Changeling Hero.
  The token Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Hero from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
